svg.text: GHOSTED: Brett Bullet-Points model sheet v1 (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)
Upright, neutral, symmetric turnaround (the side part and the swoop are the only asymmetry). Body map v1 landmarks. Direction A (the wedge). Palette rows only.
halo
top of swoop
hairline (centre)
eye line = ear points
neck line = collar
shoulder joint
chest (widest)
vest hem = waist
knee
sole
FRONT
3/4 (front turned to viewer-left)
SIDE (facing viewer-left)
BACK
PALETTE (existing rows only, seats/lena-park.md)
7 #D4503A sweater vest (the big area)
23 #FFF8EE shirt: sleeves, collar, V; teeth; eye glint
15 #F2C79E skin: head, ears, neck, hands
12 #FFE8A6 hair: the blond swoop
26 #2F3E5C chinos

2 #7FA65A the #OpenToWork HALO: the ONE green thing
22 #2B1E16 ink: outline, eyes, brows, mouth edge
Shade: base x 0.85 (neutral grey multiplier).
SHAPE RULES
- Toy pawn, the WEDGE: chest out, square
shoulders, narrow waist; 2.53 heads. 1.05 x Kit.
- Hair: high clean hairline, side part, one
blond swoop up and over. Nothing near the eyes.
- Halo: a level green ring floating above the
swoop, centred on the head axis; it follows
the head. The only green on him (+ ink edge).
- Red sweater vest over a white shirt: open
collar, no tie, white V, white sleeves.
- Grin: white teeth over an ink smile line.
- In game: chin up 10 deg (smug; opens the grin).
- Joins: shirt sleeve out of the vest armhole,
then the ball hand (3-mesh build, notes).
CONFIDENT IDLE: hands on hips; chest puffs, chin up
carriage chin up 10 deg; puff: lean back 3 deg and rise 3 u; about 2 s a cycle; feet planted
rest
puff
settle
THE LIKE (week 12): his right fist out to the side, thumb up, wink
(red: shoulder, elbow, wrist; the other hand stays at his side)
TALKING IN BULLETS: his right hand counts 1, 2, 3
a finger pops up on each bullet; mouth open; the other hand on the hip
• bullet 1
• bullet 2
• bullet 3
EXPRESSIONS (front)
rest: the grin
talk
the like: wink
secretly lost
64 px SILHOUETTE (front, 3/4; 1x and x4)
LINEUP AT THE GAME CAMERA (x2): Brett estimate on the real Dot v1 grass with Kit,
Ricky, Dot, 3 Ghosties and the ATS. Colour, then grey (Lena's formula).
GAME CAMERA NEXT TO KIT (x3): rest, like, Kit
grey below; 1x at the bottom
vest 7 vs grass 1: 2.57:1; vs path 3: 2.88:1
vest 7 vs Kit shirt 14: 1.13:1 (hue red vs blue); vs Ricky 17: 3.24:1; vs Dot 11: 1.40:1
halo 2 vs grass 1: 1.71:1 (low: the ink edge carries it); halo 2 vs hair 12: 2.31:1
shirt 23 vs vest 7: 3.98:1; hair 12 vs skin 15: 1.29:1 (low: ink hairline)
teeth 23 vs skin 15: 1.48:1 + ink smile line; chinos 26 vs vest 7: 2.55:1
In grey: a light swoop and a light V on a mid-dark wedge, dark legs. Kit mid-grey, Ricky near-black, Dot dark pear with a white dome, ATS mid, Ghosties white.
SIZE (estimate; Viet's blockout sets it):
Target 1.05 x Kit 75 px = 78.75 px tall.
This tile: 80 x 53 px without the halo,
92 px with it, facing the camera.
1 u = 3.81 mm: about 1.23 m to the swoop
top, 1.32 m to the halo top (Kit 0.977 m).
